description:
List project subscriptions

Lists the plan each of the selected project's categories holds, with its price and the payer's standing. It suits showing a project's plan wherever projects are listed; the billing overview adds billing periods, fixed charges, entitlements and usage.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/project-billing/list-project-subscriptions
name: listProjectSubscriptions

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: When the plan's fees for an interval come to less than amountCents, the difference is invoiced at the end of the period.

amountCents.description: Least the plan bills each interval, in whole cents.

subscriptions.description: One entry per category that currently holds a subscription. Empty means none do — cancelled, or never opened.

baseAmountCents.description: The plan's recurring base fee in whole cents.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. analytics or messaging.

categoryDisplayName.description: Display name for the subscription category; absent or null when unconfigured.

planName.description: The plan's customer-facing name, e.g. Messaging Pro.

tierDisplayName.description: The plan's tier as customers see it, e.g. Pro for Messaging Pro, where the category is already clear. Null when unconfigured.

title: List project subscriptions
